toegepas.blok: Ryk en arm in die graf
toegepas.voor: Ryk mense se mummie het ook
toegepas.na: Die mummie van 'n ryk mens het ook
toegepas.rede_vinder: A plural owner with a singular 'mummie' reads awkwardly; the singular owner agrees and keeps the protected word 'mummie' intact (best applied together with the next change, so 'Hulle' is not left without a clear referent).
toegepas.fout: A plural owner ('Ryk mense') with a singular 'mummie' reads awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The singular owner matches the generic singular of the sentence before it, the meaning stays the same, and 'mummie' is untouched; this only works together with change 2, which is also kept.

toegepas.blok: Ryk en arm in die graf
toegepas.voor: Hulle kon ook meer betaal vir 'n deegliker mummifisering.
toegepas.na: Ryk mense kon ook meer vir 'n deegliker mummifisering betaal.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hulle' points back two sentences past 'die sarkofaag' and 'nog 'n kis', so name the rich explicitly; the verb also belongs at the end of the clause in natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' is loose after two sentences about the coffin and the sarcophagus, and it could be read as the Egyptians in general.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'Ryk mense' makes the clear contrast with the next sentence ('Arm mense ...') and keeps 'Hulle' from being left without a referent after change 1; the people, the action and 'mummifisering' are all unchanged.

toegepas.voor: historiese bronne wat ons oor hierdie geloof leer
toegepas.na: historiese bronne waaruit ons oor hierdie geloof leer
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat ons ... leer' can be read as 'which we learn' or 'which teach us'; 'waaruit ons leer' has only the intended reading.
toegepas.fout: 'wat ons ... leer' can be read two ways: the sources teach us, or we learn the sources.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'waaruit ons leer' allows only the intended reading. The sources teach us and we learn from the sources say the same thing, so the meaning does not move.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'uitmekaarval' is a separable compound verb and is written as one word when its parts stand together (AWS 2017).
toegepas.fout: The separable compound 'uitmekaarval' is split where its parts stand together.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain spelling fix under the AWS 2017. 'ontbind' is not a decided shared definition and not a word-for-word protected wording, so a spelling correction may go in.
